description: Open GCompris and navigate to the 'Puzzle' category (icon with a yellow puzzle piece). Find and launch the 'Crane' activity (icon showing a crane/hook). Complete Level 1 and Level 2 by using the directional arrow buttons to control the crane, pick up colored items, and place them to match the target pattern shown on the right. After completing Level 2 (when the success animation finishes or the level indicator shows 3), take a screenshot of the completed state and save it to '/home/ga/crane_completion.png'.
